2607.01935.title: A-TMA: Decoupling State-Aware Memory Failures in Long-Term Agent Memory
2607.01935.paper_summary: Long term memory lets LLM agents act as persistent assistants, but user facts change. A useful memory system must know what is true now, what used to be true, and what changed. We study \emph{ghost memory}, a state coordination failure in which old, current, and transition facts coexist in the memory bank, remain mixed during retrieval, and mislead the answer model. We argue that memory systems should be understood and optimized from three levels: bank maintenance, retrieval, and answer time resolution. We propose ATMA, a state aware overlay for existing memory systems. ATMA keeps superseded and transition records in the bank, builds evidence packets for the query's requested state view, and exposes current, historical, and transition labels to QA. We further call for decoupled evaluation of bank, retrieval, and answer level failures, since final QA accuracy can hide where ghost memory occurs. To make this failure measurable, we build LTP (LoCoMo Temporal Plus), a conflict heavy benchmark for ghost memory, and evaluate on LoCoMo for long conversation generalization. On LTP, Graphiti+ATMA improves conflict accuracy by 0.240 absolute over Graphiti. On LoCoMo, Graphiti+ATMA raises temporal F1 from 0.0295 to 0.1705. The gains are host dependent, but they indicate that explicit state roles can reduce memory failures hidden by final QA accuracy.
2607.01935.paper_summary_zh: 長期記憶讓 LLM 代理人可以作為持久的助手，但用戶的事實會改變。<lb/>一個有用的記憶系統必須知道現在什麼是真實的、過去什麼是真實的，以及什麼發生了變化。<lb/>我們研究 \emph{鬼魂記憶}，這是一種狀態協調失敗，舊的、當前的和過渡的事實在記憶庫中共存，在檢索過程中保持混合，並誤導回答模型。<lb/>我們認為記憶系統應該從三個層面來理解和優化：庫的維護、檢索和回答時間解析。<lb/>我們提出 ATMA，這是一個對現有記憶系統的狀態感知覆蓋層。<lb/>ATMA 在庫中保留被取代和過渡記錄，為查詢請求的狀態視圖構建證據包，並向 QA 曝露當前、歷史和過渡標籤。<lb/>我們進一步呼籲對庫、檢索和回答層級的失敗進行解耦評估，因為最終的 QA 準確性可能掩蓋鬼魂記憶發生的地方。<lb/>為了使這一失敗可測量，我們構建了 LTP（LoCoMo Temporal Plus），這是一個針對鬼魂記憶的高衝突基準，並在 LoCoMo 上進行長對話泛化的評估。<lb/>在 LTP 上，Graphiti+ATMA 相對於 Graphiti 提高了 0.240 的衝突準確性。<lb/>在 LoCoMo 上，Graphiti+ATMA 將時間 F1 從 0.0295 提高到 0.1705。<lb/>這些增益是主機依賴的，但它們表明明確的狀態角色可以減少被最終 QA 準確性隱藏的記憶失敗。
